sources.entry: Balena Etcher - Flash OS images to SD cards & USB drives, safely and easily.

summary.one_liner: Etcher is a desktop OS image flasher, built with web technologies, for writing images to SD cards and USB drives safely.
summary.what_it_does: Etcher writes OS image files to SD cards and USB drives. According to the README, it is built with web technologies and is designed to protect against accidentally writing to hard drives. It verifies that every byte was written correctly. It can also directly flash Raspberry Pi devices that support USB device boot mode. The README lists installers for Linux, Windows 10 and later, and macOS 10.13 and later (Intel and Apple Silicon), and describes package options for Debian/Ubuntu (.deb), RHEL/Fedora (.rpm), Arch/Manjaro (AUR), WinGet, and Chocolatey.
use_cases: flash an OS image onto an SD card
write a Raspberry Pi image to a microSD card
create a bootable USB drive from an ISO
safely write disk images without overwriting hard drives
install Etcher on Linux via apt, yum, or AUR
install Etcher on Windows via WinGet or Chocolatey
how_to_run: Download the installer for your OS from the downloads page linked in the README
notable: Verifies every byte was written correctly after flashing
Guards against accidentally writing to hard drives
Can directly flash Raspberry Pi devices in USB device boot mode
Cross-platform desktop app for Linux, Windows, and macOS
caveats: Linux support is limited to Intel 64-bit systems according to the README
Windows support requires Windows 10 or later, Intel 64-bit
macOS support requires 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
